ov: قبلات مسروقة فيلم مصري إنتاج عام 2008. تاريخ عرض الفيلم يوافق عيد الفطر في مصر لعام 1429 هـ.
plotEn: Qoboulat Masrouqa is a 2008 Egyptian film directed by Khaled El Hagar and written by Ahmed Saleh. The film stars Yosra El Lozy, Ahmed Azmy, Bassem Samra and Randa El Behery, The film focuses on nine Egyptians in their twenties faced with common, but taboo subjects in Egypt: family conflicts, unemployment, sexual frustration, prostitution and violence.
